title_en: The Doorbell Said I Was Already Home
story_zh: 凌晨兩點十三分，手機跳出門鈴通知：偵測到訪客——我。但我明明坐在公寓裡。即時畫面裡，一個全身濕透的男人站在門外。他穿著我的黑外套，連左眉的疤都和我一樣。他不停說話，鏡頭卻沒有聲音。我看懂了他的嘴型：別回頭。身後的浴室，傳來一聲輕笑。我衝進去，鏡子裡的我卻沒有跟著轉身。它反而先對我笑了。門外那個我舉起手機，上面只有兩個字：躲好。我鑽進臥室衣櫃，從縫隙看向客廳。另一個我赤腳走過，濕衣服一路滴水。他從屋內打開大門，走進走廊。門鈴通知顯示：陌生人已離開。屋裡安靜了。我離開衣櫃，搭電梯下樓。電梯金屬鏡面裡，只有空蕩蕩的轎廂。我沒有倒影。手機再次震動。濕透的男人還站在門外，指著我。這一次，門鈴終於傳來他的聲音。他說：「錯的那個，逃出去了。」
story_en: At 2:13 a.m., my doorbell app sent an alert: Person detected—you. But I was sitting inside. The live view showed a soaked man outside. He wore my coat. Even the scar above his left eye matched mine. He kept speaking without sound. I read his lips: Don’t turn around. A quiet laugh came from the bathroom behind me. I ran there. My reflection did not turn with me. It smiled first. The man outside raised his phone. Two words filled its screen: Hide now. I crawled into the bedroom wardrobe and looked through the slats. Another me walked barefoot across the room, dripping water. He opened the front door from inside and stepped into the hall. The app said: Unknown person left. The apartment went silent. I left the wardrobe and took the elevator down. The metal wall showed an empty elevator. I had no reflection. My phone vibrated again. The soaked man was still outside, pointing at me. This time, his voice came through. “The wrong one escaped.”
